start: Today page, owner signed in on an online gym where the assistant is switched on

steps.action: Open the menu and tap "AI Assistant" (on a phone: the floating button)
user_sees: Header "AI Assistant" with the credits pill
Tabs "Ask" and "History"
Sections "Today for you" and "Try saying"
Link "See all {n} things it can do"
Line "Asking is free. A task uses credits only when you send or save it." or "Every {n} AI questions use 1 credit. A task uses credits when you send or save it."
must_not: The page shows before the server has answered about credits
The credits pill is empty or shows another gym's credits

steps.action: Type a request in the box "Ask or give a task, in Hindi or English" and press the send button ("Ask the AI Assistant")
user_sees: The typed words as a bubble
"Thinking…" while it works
Then an answer line or a card with the drafted task
must_not: A second request goes out while the first is still "Thinking…"
A message is sent to members or a record is changed before the owner approves the card
Credits go down for a plain question while the line says asking is free

steps.action: Approve the drafted task on its card (send or save it)
user_sees: The card says it is done (exact words on the card: unknown, cards file not read)
The credits pill goes down by the credits the task used
must_not: Credits taken twice for one task
Credits taken for a task that failed

steps.action: Tap the tab "History"
user_sees: The request at the top with its status: "Not sent", "Done", "Cancelled" or "Did not work"
For a done task that cost credits: "1 credit" or "{n} credits"
must_not: A task of another gym in the list
A done task shown as "Not sent"

start: Today page, the assistant card suggests a sentence (a sentence handed over from the Today card or "Make it")

steps.action: Tap the suggested sentence on Today
user_sees: The AI Assistant opens (full page on a phone, 420 px side panel on a computer) with the sentence in the ask box, or already asked
must_not: The sentence is asked twice
The sentence is lost and the box is empty

steps.action: Wait for the answer
user_sees: "Thinking…", then an answer or a card
must_not: The Ask tab stays on History so the answer is out of sight

start: AI Assistant page, the owner has used every question allowed today

steps.action: Look at the ask box
user_sees: The box reads "No more free questions today. Ask again tomorrow."
The microphone and send buttons are greyed
must_not: A request still goes out and is counted
The box locks with no words saying why

steps.action: Clear the box and press send with nothing typed
user_sees: Nothing happens; the send button is greyed while the box is empty
must_not: An empty request is sent and counted as a question

start: Owner types the /assistant address on a gym where the assistant is off (switched off by the panel server, a demo gym, or the gym's server does not answer about credits)

steps.action: Open the /assistant address
user_sees: Nothing for a moment, then the Today page
must_not: An empty assistant page that cannot answer
An error page
A request sent or credits used

start: AI Assistant page, owner with no tasks yet

steps.action: Tap "History"
user_sees: "Nothing yet. Tasks you give the AI Assistant show here."
must_not: An endless "Loading…"
With no internet: anything but "History could not load. Check the internet and try again."

steps.action: Tap "Ask", give a task, leave its card unapproved, tap "History"
user_sees: The task with the status "Not sent"
must_not: Credits used for a task that was only drafted

steps.action: Tap "Ask", then "Start a new chat"
user_sees: The conversation is empty; "Today for you" and "Try saying" show again
must_not: History loses the task
The drafted task is sent by clearing the chat

steps.action: Approve the task later from its row, or cancel it
user_sees: Status changes to "Done" or "Cancelled"
must_not: A cancelled task still runs
A done task can be approved a second time

start: AI Assistant page, owner asks about members by name

steps.action: Ask a question that names a member, then open History
user_sees: The request and its answer; nobody but the owner has the menu line "AI Assistant"
must_not: A staff login can open /assistant or read the owner's requests
The words are kept longer than the 400 days the privacy page says
What was typed goes anywhere other than the AI company the privacy page names
